title: His Robes for Mine
lyrics_original: For in my place He died.
What cause have I for dread?
My life is not my own.
My life is not my own.
My life is not my own.
My life is not my own.

bible_verses.english: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf; so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

I will greatly rejoice in Yahweh! My soul will be joyful in my God; for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation, he has covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decks himself with a garland, and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness; by his wounds you have been healed.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, I am humbled by the great exchange You made on the cross for me. Thank You for bearing the weight of my sin and covering me in Your perfect righteousness. When doubt or fear creeps into my heart, remind me that I am fully accepted and justified in You. Teach me to walk today with joy and freedom, wearing Your grace as my daily robe. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: The miracle of the Gospel is wrapped up in a wonderful exchange: Jesus took on the heavy, stained garments of our sin so that we could be clothed in His pristine righteousness. When God looks at you today, He sees the perfection of His Beloved Son. You no longer have to live in fear of condemnation or strive to earn acceptance. Rest deeply in the beauty of His grace, and let your heart overflow with quiet gratitude for the Savior who took your place.
